A '''lightning rod''' was a type of weapon used by the [[Ferroan]]s on [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]]. Appearing as a [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] set in a staff, it fired bolts of lightning from the crystal.
